description: Read Stack Overflow questions, answers, comments, users, tags and search results (including full-text search, similar/related/linked/featured/unanswered listings and the signed-in user profile) on stackoverflow.com in your current tab.

tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Search Stack Overflow questions using advanced search. Supports full-text query, tag filtering, date ranges, and multiple sort options. Returns questions with body content. Use this as the primary way to find relevant questions.

tools.name: get_question
tools.description: Get a specific Stack Overflow question by its ID. Returns the full question body, tags, score, answer count, and metadata. Use this to read the full content of a question.

tools.name: list_questions
tools.description: List Stack Overflow questions sorted by activity, creation date, votes, or trending periods (hot, week, month). Returns questions with body content. Use this to browse recent or popular questions.

tools.name: get_question_answers
tools.description: Get all answers for a specific Stack Overflow question. Returns answer body, score, acceptance status, and author information. Answers can be sorted by activity, creation date, or votes.

tools.name: get_question_comments
tools.description: Get comments on a specific Stack Overflow question. Returns comment body, score, and author information.

tools.name: list_related_questions
tools.description: Get questions related to a specific Stack Overflow question. Returns questions that the system considers similar based on content and tags.

tools.name: list_linked_questions
tools.description: Get questions that link to a specific Stack Overflow question. These are questions whose answers or body reference the given question.

tools.name: list_featured_questions
tools.description: List Stack Overflow questions that currently have an active bounty. These are questions where users have offered reputation as a reward for a good answer.

tools.name: list_unanswered_questions
tools.description: List Stack Overflow questions that have no upvoted or accepted answers. Useful for finding questions that need help.

tools.name: get_similar_questions
tools.description: Find Stack Overflow questions similar to a given title. Uses title-based similarity matching to find potential duplicates or related content. Useful before asking a new question to check for existing answers.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Get a specific Stack Overflow answer by its ID. Returns the full answer body, score, acceptance status, and author information.

tools.name: get_answer_comments
tools.description: Get comments on a specific Stack Overflow answer. Returns comment body, score, and author information.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get a Stack Overflow user profile by their user ID. Returns reputation, badge counts, question/answer counts, and profile information.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Search Stack Overflow users by display name. Returns matching user profiles sorted by reputation, creation date, or name.

tools.name: get_user_questions
tools.description: Get questions asked by a specific Stack Overflow user. Returns the user's questions sorted by activity, creation date, or votes.

tools.name: get_user_answers
tools.description: Get answers posted by a specific Stack Overflow user. Returns the user's answers sorted by activity, creation date, or votes.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get the currently authenticated Stack Overflow user's profile. Returns reputation, badge counts, question/answer counts, and profile information. Requires being logged in.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List Stack Overflow tags sorted by popularity or name. Tags categorize questions by topic. Use this to discover popular technologies and topics.

tools.name: get_tag_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Stack Overflow tag, including its description and wiki. Tags are the primary way questions are categorized.

tools.name: search_excerpts
tools.description: Search Stack Overflow questions and answers and return results with text excerpts containing highlighted matches. Returns both question and answer results with their excerpts. Useful for getting a quick overview of search results.
